ideas.title: Hosted INVENTHOR App Factory client portal
ideas.notes: FUTURE NON-EXECUTABLE COMMERCIAL GOAL, after live QA Factory + native Brain/Organizer continuity. INVENTHOR customer portal (Android Play / web) with ready-made, versioned, fully tested app templates: real UI + functional flows + data models + tests + upgrade support (not mockup-only). Customer picks a preview template, theme/brand/text/colors, selectable bounded addons/modules, or a bespoke request; central INVENTHOR generates a clear scope, fixed quotation and schedule; customer accepts and pays through a policy-compliant verified backend; owner Brain -> Organizer -> Operator -> Design Studio -> independent QA Factory runs the order, with receipt, manual release acceptance, delivery artifact and support/update/maintenance entitlement. Three offer lanes: (1) ready-made reusable template, (2) template customization + add-ons, (3) genuinely bespoke scoped build; optional separately billed care subscription. MVP first 2-3 proven app categories with preview/demos instead of a giant template catalog; collect real unit costs, repeat use, acceptance defects, refunds and support load before setting prices or scaling. Never duplicate owner private Brain, data, keys, local project history; each customer isolated tenant/project and only sanitized modules/features shared. Every template-generated Play app must offer distinct meaningful functionality, avoid near-duplicate spam and comply with Play review/policy; in-app digital service payment flows need actual Google Play billing/eligible exception analysis. Account, payment, deliverable copyright/license, customer acceptance, refund and data deletion need explicit terms. Future optional licensed local/portable product is separate and later. New providers optional only after QA and core continuity. IDEA_POOL is not a live instruction, executable job, deployment or price authorization.
acceptance_targets: Two or three fully working base templates with editable design, stable versioned modules, actual QA fixtures and documented upgrade paths
Preview -> choose modules -> scope and quote -> verified payment -> isolated order -> real QA -> owner release -> delivery and support
Repeatable unit-cost accounting and customer-controlled acceptance without re-running unrelated builds
Tenant/private owner data never leaks and generated Play app uniqueness and payment compliance are verified

ideas.title: Android INVENTHOR remote controller and multi-provider AI bridge
ideas.notes: Future owner-authorized Android app, following QA Factory. Owner chats with INVENTHOR in one mobile app; INVENTHOR brokers only enrolled, owner-approved AI services (GPT, Codex, Claude, Gemini, local or future permitted APIs) and controls the existing PC Main/Organizer/Operator through authenticated scoped sessions. Provider use is on-demand, free/local-first and privacy/quotas/CPU/RAM-aware; nonessential modules sleep. No universal provider-account takeover, impersonating messages, credential copying, access-control bypass, bulk unapproved provider calls, or new duplicate queue. Use official provider APIs/connectors with explicit enrollment and commercial terms. Phone app is control surface; canonical tasks, policy, leases, evidence, and QA/release remain on Main/Operator. Encrypt sync, device pairing/revocation, offline read-only status, approval gates for sensitive operations. This is a FUTURE IDEA, NOT installed, queued or a new task; do not preempt Codex QA 0.7 or ongoing Brain scope.

ideas.title: INVENTHOR Android companion: secure PC Brain and provider bridge
ideas.notes: Future app AFTER QA Factory real installed acceptance: user's Android companion chats naturally with their authorized local Windows INVENTHOR Main/Brain and Operator over a secure pairing/session gateway. Main owns canonical Organizer state, requests and capability policy; phone is a lightweight control/speech/preview/approval surface, not a duplicate Brain. Existing Provider Gateway chooses only installed and owner-approved GPT/Codex/other/local providers by verified capability, quota, price, privacy and system load; do not automatically connect every provider. Consent for sensitive actions, signed short-lived device identity, per-capability permissions, replay protection, encrypted transport, clear authenticated human-vs-agent attribution, audit and pause/revoke controls required. PC may be offline: provide transparent offline status, not fake remote execution. Load limits: one bounded job per lease, active/inactive modules, resource budgets and provider circuit breaker; provider credentials remain on trusted PC/secret store not Android client. No new executable plan or active priority before QA, no code collision with Codex.
acceptance_targets: Paired Android device sends one authorized request to the existing Main/Organizer and receives linked status/response
Full end-to-end native Operator checkpoint/receipt and independent QA evidence for one bounded task
Wrong device, leaked/replayed token, expired session, revoked capability and parallel duplicate tasks denied
Low resource use, offline notification, voice/chat UI and secure consent for sensitive actions
Installed modules/providers discovered through approved capability catalog, not uncontrolled all-provider fan-out
